subject: monster called a Worman: a giant earthworm as tall as a man, rearing upright on its thick coiled tail, disguised as an ordinary traveller. Its body is a long tube of moist pink-tan worm flesh ringed with fine segment grooves and a paler thickened band below the head, tapering to a rounded head end with no face but a small puckered mouth daubed with red paint like lipstick; a pair of round dark-glassed spectacles in thin iron wire frames perched where eyes would be, and a soft blue wool cloth cap with a short brim pulled over the top of its head. Two thin pale human-like arms grow from its front, a little below the head, with four-fingered hands; the right hand holds a short iron dagger with a leather-wrapped grip, the left hand open. The lower body bends forward and down to the ground, the tail end flattened into a broad two-lobed fluke it stands on. Arms held a little out from the body
